statements.text: So we are seeing it across our State. We had a number of people targeted through the use of AI, and unfortunate scams, so to speak. [...] So when I look at your budgetary proposal and I look at your performance plan it shows that consumer education initiatives are decreasing at the CFPB.
statements.context: Senate hearing on the CFPB Semiannual Report, where Senator Britt questions the Director about AI-enabled consumer fraud and CFPB resource allocation.

statements.text: So my first question is for you, Mr. Gorfine. How should we properly balance the strong capabilities of AI to help improve fraud detection and cybersecurity while managing the fact that these technologies can and have been used by bad actors?
statements.context: Senate Banking Committee hearing on Artificial Intelligence in Financial Services, where Senator Britt questions witnesses about balancing AI innovation with regulation.

statements.text: Technological advances such as cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and surveillance targeting have enabled companies to collect reams of personal information on consumers and change prices in under a nanosecond. [...] The Price Gouging Prevention Act introduced in this chamber would enable the FTC to implement and enforce a Federal anti-price gouging statute, saving consumers money in the 13 States that don't have price-gouging protections on the books.
statements.context: Senate Banking Committee hearing on shrinkflation and technology's impact on consumer prices.

statements.text: So I am looking at AI, computing, energy, robotics, just influence or attempts to influence our institutions, the buying up of farmland.
statements.context: Senate Banking Committee hearing on national security export controls, investment security, and the Defense Production Act.

statements.text: Mr. Torney, I know that your organization has undertaken research to determine how some of these AI platforms pose risk to children. [...] I know you mentioned earlier that they even teach you how to hide this from your parents. And I believe in parental engagement and anybody that's teaching kids to run away from their parents versus to their parents for conversation and consultation is a real red flag.
statements.context: Senator Britt questions a witness at a Senate Subcommittee hearing on harms to children from AI chatbots.

statements.text: how do we put the proper safeguards up to save lives and ultimately promote a healthier environment for this? [...] Can you describe some of the dangers with America's youth substituting real human relationships for AI chatbots?
statements.context: Senate hearing examining the harms of AI chatbots, where Senator Britt questions an expert witness about risks to children.
